name: Internship claim substantiated — mentor, stipend, shipped output

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I did a 3-month summer internship at a fintech startup. My mentor was the staff engineer on the payments team. The deliverable was a webhook-retry service — I built it in Node.js, deployed it on AWS Lambda, and it shipped to production handling about 50k events a day. The stipend was 30k per month.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Debugging an idempotency edge case in production — duplicate webhooks were causing double charges. I worked with my mentor to add a Postgres dedupe key. Available from June 1, willing to relocate.
